summary: J.Jill, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share on its common stock, payable July 8, 2026 to holders of record as of June 24, 2026. This is a routine capital return declaration, not a special situation event. The filing includes a press release and standard exhibits. No change in control, no tender, no restructuring or other special situation is involved. The event is purely a periodic dividend payment, with no structural or strategic significance beyond ordinary course.
